It is recommended that City Council take the following actions: 1) To provide for ongoing as-needed construction management and inspection services for capital improvement projects, authorize the Director of Development Services, or the Director's designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute contracts (Attachments 1-4) and any necessary amendments, task orders, and time extensions, with Dudek Engineering, Kleinfelder-Simon Wong Engineering, Caltrop: A TRC Company, and Michael Baker International, each in an amount not to exceed $200,000; 2) To provide for geotechnical, engineering geologist, and civil engineering services, authorize the Director of Development Services, or the Director's designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to enter into an agreement with Geopacifica, Inc. effective from September 29, 2017 through September 28, 2019, for a total contract amount not to exceed $275,000 for a two year period, with an extension option of two years. Contract extensions shall be at the discretion of the Development Services Director. (Attachment 5); 3) To provide for construction inspection of private development and utility/outside agency projects until the end of the 2017 calendar year, authorize the Director of Development Services, or the Director's designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to enter into a contract with Geopacifica, Inc. effective from September 29, 2017 through December 31, 2017, for an amount not to exceed $180,000 (Attachment 6). This contract will not include capital improvement inspection services; and 4) To allow for the completion of previously-authorized inspection services of four capital improvement projects that will not be covered by the short-term contract authorization in Recommendation 3 above, authorize the Director of Development Services, or the Director's designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to enter into a contract with Geopacifica, Inc. to continue inspection services in support of four capital projects currently under construction: Moonlight State Beach Marine Safety Center, Lone Jack Road Storm Drain Replacement, Annual Pavement Overlay, and Annual Sewer Rehabilitation (Attachment 7).

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
